title: Overview
description: Built-in Meridian events for one game. Pick the game at the top.

list.name: game
list.label: Game
list.query:
SELECT e.game_id, if(g.name = '', toString(e.game_id), g.name) AS label
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT game_id FROM meridian.events WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS e
LEFT JOIN (SELECT game_id, name FROM meridian.games FINAL) AS g USING (game_id)
ORDER BY label
list.definition:
SELECT e.game_id, if(g.name = '', toString(e.game_id), g.name) AS label
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT game_id FROM meridian.events WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS e
LEFT JOIN (SELECT game_id, name FROM meridian.games FINAL) AS g USING (game_id)
ORDER BY label

panels.title: Live players
panels.description: Players with any event in the last 30 seconds.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT uniqExact(session_id) AS players
FROM meridian.events
WHERE game_id = $game AND session_id != '' AND ts > now() - INTERVAL 30 SECOND

panels.title: Live servers
panels.description: Servers that sent an event in the last 30 seconds.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT uniqExact(server_id) AS servers
FROM meridian.events
WHERE game_id = $game AND ts > now() - INTERVAL 30 SECOND

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Joins in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS sessions
FROM meridian.events
WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'join' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Unique players
panels.description: Distinct players who joined in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT uniqExact(user_id) AS players
FROM meridian.events
WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'join' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Median session
panels.description: Median length of sessions that ended in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT quantileExact(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(props, 'duration')) AS median
FROM meridian.events
WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'leave' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Purchases
panels.description: Completed product and game pass purchases in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS purchases
FROM meridian.events
WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'purchase' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Active players
panels.description: Distinct players with any event in each interval.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, uniqExact(session_id) AS players
FROM meridian.events
WHERE game_id = $game AND session_id != '' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, countIf(event = 'join') AS joins, countIf(event = 'leave') AS leaves
FROM meridian.events
WHERE game_id = $game AND event IN ('join', 'leave') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Session length
panels.description: Sessions that ended in the selected time range, by length.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    multiIf(d < 60, '< 1m', d < 300, '1-5m', d < 900, '5-15m', d < 1800, '15-30m', d < 3600, '30-60m', '60m+') AS length,
    count() AS sessions
FROM (
    SELECT JSONExtractFloat(props, 'duration') AS d
    FROM meridian.events
    WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'leave' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
)
GROUP BY length
ORDER BY min(d)

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, count() AS deaths
FROM meridian.events
WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'death' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
    concat(JSONExtractString(props, 'kind'), ' ', JSONExtractRaw(props, 'id')) AS item,
    count() AS purchases,
    uniqExact(user_id) AS buyers
FROM meridian.events
WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'purchase' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY item
ORDER BY purchases DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Top events
panels.description: All events except position samples, including custom events from Meridian.Track.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event, count() AS count, uniqExactIf(user_id, user_id != 0) AS players
FROM meridian.events
WHERE game_id = $game AND event != 'position' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY event
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Position heatmap
panels.description: Player position samples binned on the X/Z plane. Change the cell size at the top.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    (floor(x / $cell) + 0.5) * $cell AS cell_x,
    (floor(z / $cell) + 0.5) * $cell AS cell_z,
    count() AS samples
FROM meridian.events
WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'position' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY cell_x, cell_z
ORDER BY samples
LIMIT 20000
